notes: Site: beruru.com (Shopify). Tier-1 direct HTTP fetch used throughout, no block encountered. Checked: (1) full collections sitemap (98 handles) grepped case-insensitively for new/arrival/just-in/latest/recently-added/whats-new - zero matching collection handles. (2) Direct URL probing of common New Arrivals handles - /collections/new-arrivals, /collections/new-in, /collections/new-products, /collections/just-in, /collections/whats-new, /collections/latest-arrivals, /collections/recently-added - all HTTP 404. (3) Homepage main-nav collection-link scan - no New Arrivals/New In/Just In/Latest Arrivals/What's New wording anywhere in the nav. (4) Shopify's own predictive-search API (/search/suggest.json, resources[type]=collection) for 'new arrivals' and 'new' returned an empty collections array (resources.results.collections: []) - the site's own search layer confirms no collection matches these terms. (5) Inspected the one ambiguous 'Collection'-style candidate found in the sitemap: /collections/fresh-picks. Opened it: og:title/h1 'Fresh Picks', 465 products (a large fraction of the whole catalog based on comparison with other broad buckets like the 763-item 'High Value Products' price-tier collection). Its own meta description reads 'Buy fresh collection of furnitures, decorative items online at Beruru. Find most stylish & luxury fresh collections' - framing it as a curated style/quality merchandising bucket, not a 'recently added to catalogue' concept, and it does not match any of the brief's target terms (New Arrivals/New In/Just In/Latest Arrivals/What's New/Recently Added/New Collection). No page copy, breadcrumb, or nav placement ties 'Fresh Picks' to product recency. Given its own copy explicitly frames it around style/luxury rather than newness, and its size (465, far larger than any other merchandising cut on the site) is inconsistent with a genuine 'just added' curated list, it was excluded rather than recorded with an ambiguous flag. Conclusion: no genuine New Arrivals-type PLP exists on this site as of this pass.
